name: Kokkai-Gijidomae
tagline: Otemachi in 6 minutes and Tokyo in 7 minutes. Served by 2 lines. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥160,000 to ¥170,000.
summary: The station is in Chiyoda City, where Tokyo Metro run 2 lines between them. Journey times to the main business districts are 6 minutes to Otemachi, 12 minutes to Shinjuku, 15 minutes to Shibuya and 21 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥160,000 to ¥170,000. The station stands 25 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 17.7 m. The land around the station has gentle slopes.

terrain.note: The station sits on the higher side of the ground around it, at 25 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 7.3 m to 25 m, a difference of 17.7 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls outside the projected inundation area. Even so, 2 of the nine points within 400 m fall inside the area, and the deepest projection there is less than 0.5 m. On the whole, the flood projection here is among the smallest in the 23 wards.
medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 14 clinics and 19 pharmacies. Day-to-day care is available close to the station. The nearest hospital is 虎の門病院, about 10 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 友仁会赤坂見附前田病院, about 18 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 2 lines serve the station. Tokyo Metro Marunouchi Line run through it. Tokyo Metro Chiyoda Line also call here. Both lines are run by Tokyo Metro, so a fault affecting that company can stop them together.
congestion: Tokyo Metro Marunouchi Line runs at 154% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 新大塚→茗荷谷, which this station is not on. Tokyo Metro Chiyoda Line runs at 150%. Its busiest stretch is 町屋→西日暮里, which this station is likewise not on. At 150%, the ministry's scale describes shoulders not quite touching, with crowding near the doors. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥160,000 to ¥170,000 and 1K ¥150,000 to ¥160,000. 1LDK ¥290,000 to ¥300,000 and 2LDK ¥470,000 to ¥480,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.
drivers: Age and construction of the building
Whether it faces a main road or the railway
Whether it sits at the top or the bottom of a slope

rentReason: A one-room flat here goes for ¥160,000 to ¥170,000. For 1LDK, 2LDK, though, the sources differ by ¥30,000 or more. They count different sets of properties, so read those figures as a range rather than a point.

neighbours.lead: Tameike-Sanno is ahead on how easy the shopping is, but Kokkai-Gijidomae is ahead on how little of the area is in the flood projection.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Kokkai-Gijidomae. It takes 9 minutes longer to reach Otemachi than Kokkai-Gijidomae.

neighbours.lead: Kasumigaseki is ahead on the number of lines, but Kokkai-Gijidomae is ahead on how easy the shopping is.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Kokkai-Gijidomae. It reaches Otemachi in about the same time as Kokkai-Gijidomae.

goodFor: People commuting to Otemachi and Marunouchi
notFor: People who want to finish their shopping on foot
People who want to hold the rent down
noiseSources: The 首都高速都心環状線 viaduct runs just outside the station. It is an expressway, so traffic is audible day and night
東京都道二四七号線 (3 lanes each way) runs right beside the station. Traffic on it never stops, so for a flat close to the station, check whether it faces the road

leads.terrain: There are gentle slopes around the station, and which block you live on changes how much effort getting about takes.
leads.groceries: There are 5 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 11 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: The station itself is outside the projected flood area, but blocks nearby are inside it.
leads.stationNote: 2 lines serve the station. The choice of connections is about average for the 23 wards.
leads.rentRange: Set against how long the commute takes, rents here are on the high side.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is among the highest in the 23 wards.
leads.congestion: Among the 23 wards' stations, the lines here are heavily loaded in the morning.
leads.noiseSources: At this station, check the traffic noise before the noise people make.
